name: EPIC 204995748
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 13.1 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 204995748 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.087281 (16th-84th percentiles 12.355014-13.983647), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 204995748 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.970991 (16th-84th percentiles 0.849578-1.131432), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 204995748: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4638.868 +/- 147 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 204995748 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3410.742188 (16th-84th percentiles 3242.734375-3594.375), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 1.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,411 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.97 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,639 K at its surface.
